name: homemade-skills-claude-code
description: Homemade skills for Claude Code, distilled from everyday work.

plugins.name: writer
plugins.description: Rewrites a Russian draft — a post, a chapter, a note — so it reads alive: finds the buried detail, restores scenes, kills dead verbs, fixes rhythm, keeps the author's voice. Tuned for LiveJournal and vc.ru.

plugins.name: image-gen
plugins.description: Prompt to PNG on disk through OpenRouter — seedream, gpt-image, qwen-image — plus rembg background removal, with the prompting lore that makes the frames usable.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Check a risky hypothesis against an independent LLM — DeepSeek, Gemini, GPT, Grok, or any model on OpenRouter — through one OpenAI-compatible script.

plugins.name: feature-pipeline
plugins.description: Route a feature through spec, outside opinion, implementation and independent verification while the main context only orchestrates: feature-pipeline (Grok Build or DeepSeek implements), local-pipeline (pinned Claude subagents), cheap-pipeline (low-cost crew), and opus-pipeline (simple tracker tasks in parallel worktrees: Opus implements, a Sonnet judge verifies and commits). Stage questions are relayed to the author; an opt-in hook auto-approves the pipeline agents' non-destructive commands.

plugins.name: skill-smith
plugins.description: Engineering discipline for Claude Code configuration: pick the right mechanism before writing anything, take the frontmatter from the live docs instead of memory, match the wording to the failure it fixes, and ship only after a static validator and a fresh-context trigger check.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Compose, Traefik and self-hosted GitHub Actions deploys the way a single-host server actually runs them: two canons for shipping an image, rsync onto a live directory, and the traps that cost a day each — apt mirrors, inode-bound read-only binds, silent production ACME.
